scope: Pinned OpenJDK Mobile iOS Zero bootstrap resource layout; static source inspection and original unsigned IPA inspection only.
sourceLineNumberMethod: All source anchors use 1-based physical line numbers counted from the pinned raw GitHub file content, including empty lines; web extraction line numbers are not used.

originalArtifactInspection.method: Python zipfile.ZipFile central-directory inspection and hashlib.file_digest SHA-256; no extraction or mutation.
originalArtifactInspection.interpretation: The classes were packaged, but neither bootstrap layout searched under the static iOS VM's early Java home was present. Checking only the configured nested Java home could therefore report a successful payload preflight while leaving native bootstrap unable to locate java.base.

conditions.platform: The Apple branch of os::init_system_properties_values with __IOS__ defined.
conditions.linkage: The is_vm_statically_linked() branch is required for the appended /lib. This probe links the source-built libjvm.a into libOpenJDK.a and that static archive into the app executable; it does not load a separate libjvm dynamic library. The official static iOS example independently uses the matching bundle layout.
conditions.staticBuildTerminology: STATIC_BUILD denotes the upstream static build path; the home calculation is guarded by the runtime helper is_vm_statically_linked(), not by a literal #ifdef STATIC_BUILD in os_bsd.cpp. Do not generalize this result to a dynamically linked macOS JVM.
conditions.addressResolution: For VM code statically linked into LegadoRuntimeProbe, dladdr resolves the app Mach-O executable. The source then strips the executable filename, retains the app directory under __IOS__, and appends /lib for the static VM.

sourceChain.finding: Threads::create_vm initializes system properties before Arguments::parse(args). Ordinary VM options, including -Djava.home, cannot repair a failure during that earlier initialization.
Arguments::init_system_properties creates the initially unset java.home property and calls os::init_system_properties_values synchronously.

The Apple code obtains os::jvm_path, removes the final filename, skips the two parent-directory removals under __IOS__, appends /lib for a statically linked VM, sets java.home, and immediately requires set_boot_path to succeed. Failure invokes vm_exit_during_initialization.
dll_address_to_library_name uses dladdr's dli_fname for the address-containing image. In this app's static linkage, that image is the app executable.

os::jvm_path discovers and canonicalizes the address-containing image. Its JAVA_HOME override is inside Arguments::executing_unit_tests(); merely setting JAVA_HOME in an ordinary embedded app does not select the nested Java home through this path. No supported public pre-JNI home setter was identified in this audit.

os::set_boot_path first tests <java.home>/lib/modules as a jimage, then <java.home>/modules/java.base as exploded classes. Both absent returns false. With the derived early home, the physical candidates are App.app/lib/lib/modules and App.app/lib/modules/java.base.

Later Java module discovery also uses java.home: lib/modules for a runtime image or modules for an exploded build. Keeping the native early home and configured java.home equal avoids a second, inconsistent module location.

The initialization error overload calls vm_abort(false), which forwards to os::abort(false). The POSIX implementation calls os::_exit(1); ::abort() is only used when dump_core is true. This source path can terminate the process without a signal crash report, but does not prove which path the reported device execution took.

The JNI vfprintf hook is installed during option parsing, after early system-property initialization. A stage log stopping at JNI_CreateJavaVM.before with an empty vm-output.log or no hs_err file would therefore not exclude this earlier layout failure.

officialPinnedExample.packagingFinding: The official sample creates HelloMobileApp/lib/lib and copies the jimage modules file there. In the built app this is App.app/lib/lib/modules, matching early java.home=App.app/lib.
officialPinnedExample.startupFinding: The sample passes one VM option for java.class.path, calls loadfunctions, then JNI_CreateJavaVM. It does not depend on -Djava.home or JAVA_HOME to redirect the early resource lookup.
officialPinnedExample.executionClaim: Reference source inspected; the upstream sample was not executed locally.

minimalCorrection.approach: Move the complete exploded Java home from App.app/LegadoRuntime/java-home to App.app/lib while preparing the built app, and configure java.home to App.app/lib.
minimalCorrection.otherResources: Move conf, lib runtime data, legal notices and release together with modules; keep JARs and runtime-manifest.json under App.app/LegadoRuntime.
minimalCorrection.validationAtRecordTime: Correction submitted for cloud build; this investigation does not assert the resulting simulator or device runtime passed.

requiredReproduction: Capture the original-layout diagnostic build's actual process exit and native stage/VM output evidence, including an explicit bootstrap error if available.
Inspect the corrected built app or IPA to prove the early bootstrap candidate and configured java.home now identify the same complete Java home.
Run the corrected simulator and self-signed physical-device probe without treating successful packaging or payload preflight as a JVM-start pass.
Keep G1-G5 pending until their existing runtime assertions actually pass; retain both original and corrected artifacts and reports.
limits: The original IPA inspection confirms a packaging defect relative to the pinned static iOS bootstrap lookup. It does not establish that this was the only device startup failure.
No signal handler, fatal-error recovery, private JAVA_HOME override, or speculative JVM parameter change is part of this correction.
Native JVM initialization, java.beans, the 25-case semantic suite, synthetic reading flow and cancellation have not been established as passing on the reported device by this investigation.
